# Mahjongers

> Mahjongers helps mahjong teachers, hosts, clubs and shops grow, with two services priced in US dollars: Mahjongers Websites (website design with booking, payments, SEO and AI visibility) and Mahjongers Social (done-for-you social media management for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and LinkedIn). Operated by Move78 Hospitality, India.

## Services
- [Mahjongers Websites — website design plans](https://mahjongers.com/website-design): Starter $1,250 one-time + $49/month care (up to 3 pages, live in 15 days), Pro $2,500 + $99/month (up to 8 pages, booking and Stripe payments, blog, full SEO and AI-visibility setup, live in 30 days), Max $5,000 + $199/month (up to 20 pages, shop and memberships, monthly AI-visibility tracking, live in 60 days). AI Visibility add-on $300/month for any website. Clients own their domain and content.
- [Mahjongers Social — plans and pricing](https://mahjongers.com/social-media): Starter $350/month (2 platforms, 12 posts incl. 4 Reels), Pro $750/month (3 platforms, 20 posts incl. 8 Reels, Stories, DMs), Max $1,500/month (4 platforms, 30 posts incl. 12 Reels, daily Stories and DMs, paid ads managed). 3-month minimum, then month to month. Clients keep ownership of their accounts.
- [Get started](https://mahjongers.com/join): contact form for new clients.
